# Included music

Two starter tracks, published by their respective authors on OpenGameArt under CC0. Commercial use and redistribution are permitted by the CC0 dedication to the extent it applies. Retain the source records so the library does not confuse these tracks with user uploads or other sites' custom licences. No promise is made that an automated Content ID system will never flag a track.

- Face The Facts — Zane Little Music: https://opengameart.org/content/face-the-facts
- Our Expanse — Bobjt: https://opengameart.org/content/our-expanse
- CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Audio files are MP3, 48 kHz stereo, 128 kbps, normalised for background use. Music is not automatically added: the editor chooses it and confirms placement. Narration stays present and the engine can duck the music under speech.

## Curated Show additions — 25 October 2026

Six Kevin MacLeod tracks from Incompetech: Sneaky Snitch, Monkeys Spinning Monkeys, Investigations, Local Forecast, Carefree and Airport Lounge. Each is CC BY 4.0 according to the official catalogue and attribution template. Author, original page and licence URL are in catalog.json. Attribution is required in users’ published videos/descriptions. Files were loudness-normalised to -20 LUFS / -2 dBTP and encoded as 96 kbps MP3. They remain complete tracks, not misleading short previews. Evidence of the official catalogue/template is retained alongside this README. Importing a YouTube link does not confer music rights. No subscription was purchased.
